title: 第17章 叛逆的柳依依第18章 供奉救我
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
“不玩。”
“怂蛋，我姐以前怎么会看上你！”
姐姐跟外甥闺女不在，加上叶琳也醉倒了，柳依依不再掩饰对叶凡的鄙视。
对此。
叶凡没有回答。
柳依依更加鄙视了：“昨天是这样，现在还是这样，叶凡你到底是不是男人，怎么一点脾气也没有。”
“因为你是盈盈的妹妹，我把你当家人，我不会对家人发怒。”
“嘁，说的比唱的还好听，那你当初倒是别抛弃我姐啊。”
柳依依越说越气，将冰桶里的红酒举起想要砸向叶凡。
叶凡没躲。
目光平静望着柳依依。
时间于这一刻仿佛静止，就连酒吧的喧闹嘈杂也变得不再刺耳。
柳依依握紧红酒瓶，举了半天也没下手，烦闷交加的她直接对瓶吹，咕咚咕咚一口喝完。
酒不醉人人自醉。
柳依依替姐姐委屈，声音哽咽质问道：“叶凡，你知道我姐为你牺牲了多少吗？我恨你，我这辈子也不可能原谅你！”
丢下这句话。
柳依依大口喝酒，像是要把自己灌醉一样。
叶凡皱眉：“差不多了，别喝了，我带你们回家。”
“起开，我不用你管！”
柳依依明显有些醉了，甩开叶凡的手，扶着楼梯摇摇晃晃去了一楼舞池。

她穿着清凉的吊带衫跟热裤，随着音乐节拍肆意舞动身体，身材火辣迷人，周遭有不少贪婪的视线扫视而来。
甚至还有男人想要借机揩油，被柳依依狠狠踩了一脚。
“想占姑奶奶便宜？做梦去吧。”柳依依喝醉了，脾气也变大了。
“美女，都是来酒吧玩的，认识一下呗。”
“说的好听，无非是惦记着裤裆里的那点事，恶心！”
柳依依嫌恶说完，扭头看向二楼。
发现叶凡还在盯着自己，顿时气鼓鼓的竖了根中指，然后去了卫生间。
叶凡有些头疼。
柳依依像极了青春期叛逆少女。
劝是没用的，叶凡抱着妹妹叶琳，在酒吧旁边的酒店开了一间房，安置好妹妹后又返回酒吧。
叶凡打算强行带走柳依依，哪怕被骂也无所谓，谁让她是柳盈盈的妹妹呢。
只是在二楼卡座等了十分钟，柳依依依旧没回来。
难道还在卫生间？
叶凡神色一沉，心中隐有不妙升起。
酒吧这地方鱼龙混杂，对于喝醉的女性特别不友好，像柳依依这种姿色更是人人都想吃一口。
叶凡不敢耽搁，散开神识。
“还在酒吧，但不在一楼，在三楼！”
叶凡睁开眼睛，其内寒光一闪。
从二楼到三楼需要坐电梯，不仅需要输入密码，还有体形壮硕的保安守在电梯口。
“我朋友在三楼，麻烦让一下。”

“滚，三楼不对外营业。”
保安语气不善，刚才的确有个漂亮女人被强行带了上去，莫非是这小子的女朋友？
他戏谑道：“在这等着吧，运气好明天早上就会下来，把上面的那些大人物伺候好了，你说不定还能跟着沾光。”
“砰！”
content_en:
"Not playing."
"Coward, how could my sister have fallen in love with you before?"
With her sister and niece away, and Ye Lin also drunk, Liu Yiyi no longer concealed her contempt for Ye Fan.
To this.
Ye Fan did not answer.
Liu Yiyi became even more contemptuous: "It was like this yesterday, and it's still like this now. Ye Fan, are you a man? Why don't you have any temper at all?"
"Because you are Yingying's sister, I treat you as a family member, and I will not be angry with my family."
"Hey, what you say is better than what you sing. Then you should not have abandoned my sister in the first place."
The more Liu Yiyi talked, the angrier she became. She raised the red wine in the ice bucket and wanted to hit Ye Fan.
Ye Fan didn't hide.
He looked at Liu Yiyi calmly.
Time seemed to stand still at this moment, and even the noise in the bar became no longer harsh.
Liu Yiyi held the red wine bottle tightly and held it up for a long time without moving. Feeling bored, she blew on the bottle and drank it in one gulp.
If the wine is not intoxicating, everyone will get drunk.
Liu Yiyi felt wronged for her sister and asked with a choked voice: "Ye Fan, do you know how much my sister has sacrificed for you? I hate you, and I will never forgive you in this life!"
Drop this sentence.
Liu Yiyi drank heavily, as if she was trying to get herself drunk.
Ye Fan frowned: "It's almost done. Stop drinking. I'll take you home."
"Get started, I don't need you to worry about it!"
Liu Yiyi was obviously a little drunk. She shook off Mark's hand and staggered to the dance floor on the first floor while holding on to the stairs.
Wearing a cool halter top and hot pants, she danced her body wantonly to the beat of the music. Her figure was hot and charming, and many greedy eyes glanced around her.
There were even men who wanted to take advantage of the opportunity, but were severely stepped on by Liu Yiyi.
"Want to take advantage of my aunt? Just dream." Liu Yiyi got drunk and became angry.
"Beauties, they all come to the bar to hang out. Let's get to know each other."
"It sounds nice, but it's just that you're thinking about what's in your crotch. It's disgusting!"
Liu Yiyi finished speaking in disgust and turned to look at the second floor.
Realizing that Mark was still staring at him, he immediately raised his middle finger angrily and went to the bathroom.
Ye Fan had a headache.
Liu Yiyi looks like a rebellious adolescent girl.
The persuasion was useless. Ye Fan hugged his sister Ye Lin and opened a room in the hotel next to the bar. After settling his sister, he returned to the bar.
Ye Fan planned to take Liu Yiyi away by force, even if she was scolded, it didn't matter. Who said she was Liu Yingying's sister.
After just ten minutes of waiting in the booth on the second floor, Liu Yiyi still didn't come back.
Are you still in the bathroom?
Ye Fan's expression sank, and something bad arose in his heart.
The bar was a mixed bag, and it was particularly unfriendly to drunk women. Everyone wanted to take a bite of Liu Yiyi's beauty.
Ye Fan didn't dare to delay and spread his consciousness.
"Still in the bar, but not on the first floor, on the third floor!"
Ye Fan opened his eyes, and a cold light flashed inside them.
You need to take the elevator from the second floor to the third floor. Not only do you need to enter a password, but there are also sturdy security guards guarding the elevator entrance.
"My friend is on the third floor, please give way."
"Go away, the third floor is closed to the public."
The security guard's tone was unkind. There was indeed a beautiful woman who was forcibly brought up just now. Could it be that she was this guy's girlfriend?
He joked: "Just wait here. If you're lucky, you'll come down tomorrow morning and take care of the big shots above. You might even be able to benefit from it."
"Bang!"
